subject: Control room: close stabilization & temporary cadence for HelixHealth MAP
messages:
From: Samantha Diaz <samantha@helixhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Keller <tom.keller@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Potential push on go-live due to security evidence delay

Soojin —

Quick update from our side: the security team requested additional evidence for data retention and audit logging (SOC2 extract + table-by-table retention policy). We submitted what we had last week, but the reviewer flagged two outstanding items that may take their vendor an extra 7–10 business days to produce.

Given that these artifacts are on the critical path for our internal approval board, there is now a non-trivial chance the go-live date in the MAP slips by 2–3 weeks unless we run parallel mitigation. My PM asked me to surface this immediately so we can decide whether to:

- pause the final acceptance milestone, or
- run a soft-launch with limited scope while the evidence is completed, or
- fund an accelerated SOC extract from the vendor (we can explore the cost).

Can Redwood stand up a short "control room" cadence this week — daily 15m standups and a single point of contact for verification steps? We need to lock what we do in the next 24 hours so procurement has a clear path.

Attachments: SOC2-extract-2026.pdf (what we sent to the reviewer)

Thanks,
Samantha Diaz
Director, Program Management — HelixHealth
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Diaz <samantha@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Potential push on go-live due to security evidence delay

Thanks for flagging, Samantha —

We can absolutely stand up a control-room cadence. Proposal (quick):

1) Control room cadence: daily 15m standup (Mon–Fri) 9:00am PT, starting tomorrow. Owner: Marissa Cole (CS lead).
2) Short-term mitigation: soft-launch with read-only access for 2 internal teams (no PHI exports) while full evidence completes.
3) Technical fallback: isolated VPC route + additional audit-trace enabled (no schema changes) for meanwhile; engineering estimate: 8–12 hours of work to validate and deploy.
4) Commercial: we can offer a 2-week credit against month 1 if the final acceptance slips beyond agreed MAP date — will confirm with Sales & RevOps.

Jonas / Marissa — I’m looping you to operationalize the control room and confirm the deployment window. Ben, can you draft a short amendment we can run through procurement if Helix wants the soft-launch option?

Samantha — if you can send a calendar invite for an initial 30m kickoff (control room + key reviewers), I’ll have Marissa bring the action tracker. We will add an explicit verification checklist to the MAP (we’ll update helix_map_v3.xlsx).

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Samantha Diaz <samantha@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Potential push on go-live due to security evidence delay

Good catch and thanks, team. A couple points from GTM/Commercial:

- Please treat this as a short escalation — I want exec visibility until the control room stabilizes the plan. I will make a quick note to our VP of Sales.
- Ben: please prepare a concise amendment offering (1) two-week service credit if final acceptance slips beyond the MAP close date, and (2) temporary soft-launch terms (scope, limited users, data partitions). We should avoid open-ended concessions.
- Marissa: run the control-room schedule and publish an action log (CSV) so procurement can consume it.

Samantha — we’re prepared to move fast on the technical side. If Helix can sign the amendment, we can implement the isolated staging route by EOD the next business day. If procurement needs a DocuSign, Ben can coordinate.

Attaching control-room-schedule-v1.pdf for the proposed daily cadence.

Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: HelixHealth Procurement <procure@helixhealth.com>, Samantha Diaz <samantha@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Draft amendment & temporary credit proposal for MAP close date

Hi Samantha / Helix procurement —

Following our conversations, please find a short-form amendment draft attached (amendment-Draft-Helix-2026.docx). Summary of the key commercial and operational bullets:

- Revised acceptance milestone: move final acceptance from 2026-10-28 to 2026-11-11 (two-week contingency) unless the control room confirms earlier clearance.
- Temporary soft-launch option: limited to the Internal QA and Analytics teams; read-only by default; no export of regulated fields (PHI redaction enforced).
- Commercial concession: if final acceptance is delayed beyond 2026-11-11, Redwood will apply a 10% credit to Helix's first full-month invoice (capped at $25k).
- Procurement ask: if Helix accepts the amendment in principle, provide approval to execute via DocuSign OR share your internal PO reference to expedite SOW changes.

Next steps: please confirm preferred execution path (DocuSign vs PO) and any edits to the amendment language by EOD 2026-10-21 so we can push the technical changes to staging.

Attachments: amendment-Draft-Helix-2026.docx

Thanks — Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Diaz <samantha@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, HelixHealth Procurement <procure@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft amendment & temporary credit proposal for MAP close date

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. HelixPROC and I discussed this morning. We are willing to:

1) Accept the amendment language in principle (the two-week contingency and 10% credit are acceptable).
2) Proceed with the soft-launch for Internal QA + Analytics on a read-only footprint.
3) We will provide a PO reference (PO# HLX-5042) and prefer DocuSign for the amendment — procurement will route internally tomorrow.

Requests/clarifications before we sign:
- Can Redwood confirm that audit logs for the soft-launch window will be preserved and exported for our reviewers? (We need a single audit bundle for that period.)
- Please include the control-room daily action log as an appendix to the amendment (Marissa, thanks in advance).

If we have answers to the two bullets above, procurement will execute DocuSign and we can start the control room cadence on Monday. Appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
Samantha Diaz
Director, Program Management — HelixHealth
